purpose: Falsify whether the Portfolio Risk concentration conclusion depends on HHI as the chosen inequality metric.

metrics.HHI: sum of squared normalized projected-risk contribution shares
metrics.GINI: pairwise absolute-difference Gini on projected-risk contributions
metrics.CV: population standard deviation / mean of projected-risk contributions

search: Exhaustive legal NT$1,000-grid allocation states under same names, same deployment and 35% per-name cap.
falsification: If direction changes materially across metrics (for example current <= equal-capital on several non-HHI measures), downgrade the structural conclusion as metric-sensitive.
guardrails: metric-specific global optima may differ and are not live recommendations
all metrics operate on plan-time projected risk, not realized loss
one reconstructable multi-name date remains a sample limitation
